chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's Sword Heart Illumination – Breaking Beishan Xuantang's Five Qi Capture
chapter_meta_description: In the Dao Debate Palace, Ji Ning faces Beishan Xuantang's overwhelming Five Qi Grand Capture. Cornered, he unlocks the first stance of the Three-Foot Sword—Sword Heart Illumination—and shatters his opponent with a thousand flying swords.
og_title: Sword Heart Illumination – Ji Ning's First Stance
og_description: Watch Ji Ning channel two lifetimes of pain and clarity into a single, devastating sword strike that overwhelms a Domain of the Dao expert.
twitter_title: Ji Ning unlocks Sword Heart Illumination!
twitter_description: A thousand flying swords unite as one as Ji Ning's Dao-heart reaches perfect clarity against Beishan Xuantang's Five Qi Grand Capture.
